svg.title: Online Auction Bid Gates
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-online-deed-bid-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Online Auction Bid Gates; subtitle: Four checks before a parcel earns a bid; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Is there a current photo or boots on the ground?; pass next: G2; fail action: No bid; county and Street View shots run years stale.; gate: G2; question: Does the property appraiser site confirm usage and description?; pass next: G3; fail action: Drop it; never rely on the vendor's assessed value or listing photo, and eliminate landlocked parcels.; gate: G3; question: Is title clear of hidden, municipal and IRS liens, plus any surviving deed of trust on Texas redemption deeds?; pass next: G4; fail action: Pass, or price the encumbrance before going further.; gate: G4; question: Is the exit chosen (quiet title or as-is wholesale) and a CMA-based maximum written down?; pass next: Bid up to the written maximum and stay emotionally uninvolved.; fail action: Hold off until the exit and ceiling are fixed.; caption: Cheap online deeds still demand a current image, appraiser-site verification, a title search and a fixed exit before any bid.; assumptions note: Practitioners disagree on buying sight-unseen; these gates follow the stricter view. Tax Sale Secrets reports losing seven or eight Florida properties before winning one under disciplined maximums.; note: Sources: Tax Sale Secrets (IMGzMnzQiZQ @ 01:29:27; RgLErVu5_Kk @ 00:29:54, 00:48:38; AO4ZqaMio7s @ 00:27:24); The Jackie Jackson | Tax Deed & Real Estate Coach (Pz2ZCMuIox4 @ 00:12:04); Ted Thomas (41UuQtBLiBo @ 00:03:04).

rect.title: gate: G1; question: Is there a current photo or boots on the ground?; pass next: G2; fail action: No bid; county and Street View shots run years stale.

gate: G2; question: Does the property appraiser site confirm usage and description?; pass next: G3; fail action: Drop it; never rely on the vendor's assessed value or listing photo, and eliminate landlocked parcels.

gate: G3; question: Is title clear of hidden, municipal and IRS liens, plus any surviving deed of trust on Texas redemption deeds?; pass next: G4; fail action: Pass, or price the encumbrance before going further.

gate: G4; question: Is the exit chosen (quiet title or as-is wholesale) and a CMA-based maximum written down?; pass next: Bid up to the written maximum and stay emotionally uninvolved.; fail action: Hold off until the exit and ceiling are fixed.

text.title: Assumptions: Practitioners disagree on buying sight-unseen; these gates follow the stricter view. Tax Sale Secrets reports losing seven or eight Florida properties before winning one under disciplined maximums.
